tools.name: evaluate_script
tools.description: Run JS in React Native app context (not WebView). Returns JSON result. For WebView JS, use webview_evaluate_script. Use measureView(uid) for coords.

function.description: JS function string. E.g. "() => measureView(uid)". require() not available.

deviceId.description: Target device ID. Auto if single device. Use get_debugger_status to list.

platform.description: Target platform. Auto when single device of that platform.

tools.name: take_snapshot
tools.description: Capture component tree. Compact text output. uid = testID or path for tap/swipe. Use interactive=true for minimal token usage.

interactive.description: If true, show only interactive elements (Touchable, Button, TextInput, Switch, etc.).

deviceId.description: Target device ID. Auto if single device. Use get_debugger_status to list.

platform.description: Target platform. Auto when single device of that platform.

tools.name: take_screenshot
tools.description: Capture device screen as JPEG. EXPENSIVE: consumes large image tokens. Prefer text-based tools first: query_selector/assert_text for native UI, webview_evaluate_script for WebView DOM. Use screenshot only when visual layout check is needed or text tools cannot verify the state. After one screenshot, switch back to text-based tools.

platform.description: android: adb. ios: simctl (simulator only).

tools.name: accessibility_audit
tools.description: Run accessibility audit on component tree. Returns violations with rule, selector, and severity.

deviceId.description: Target device ID. Auto if single device. Use get_debugger_status to list.

platform.description: Target platform. Auto when single device of that platform.

tools.name: webview_evaluate_script
tools.description: Run JS inside a WebView (DOM query, click, read text, etc). Use this instead of tap for any WebView content — tap cannot target DOM elements. Get webViewId via evaluate_script with getRegisteredWebViewIds().

webViewId.description: WebView id. Use evaluate_script getRegisteredWebViewIds() to discover.

script.description: JS to run in WebView (DOM query, click, etc). Must evaluate to value for result.

deviceId.description: Target device ID. Auto if single device. Use get_debugger_status to list.

platform.description: Target platform. Auto when single device of that platform.

tools.name: type_text
tools.description: Type text into TextInput by uid (from query_selector). Supports Unicode. Use instead of input_text for non-ASCII.

uid.description: testID or path of TextInput. Get from query_selector first.

deviceId.description: Target device ID. Auto if single device. Use get_debugger_status to list.

platform.description: Target platform. Auto when single device of that platform.

tools.name: query_selector
tools.description: Find first RN element matching selector. Returns uid, type, and position (pageX, pageY, width, height) in points — use these coordinates directly with tap. For WebView inner elements, use webview_evaluate_script instead.

selector.description: Selector for RN Fiber tree. Read resource docs://guides/query-selector-syntax for full syntax (type, #testID, :text, hierarchy, etc.).

deviceId.description: Target device ID. Auto if single device. Use get_debugger_status to list.

platform.description: Target platform. Auto when single device of that platform.

tools.name: query_selector_all
tools.description: Find all RN elements matching selector. Returns array with positions (pageX, pageY, width, height) in points. Use query_selector for single element.

selector.description: Selector for RN Fiber tree. Read resource docs://guides/query-selector-syntax for full syntax (type, #testID, :text, hierarchy, etc.).

platform.description: Target platform. Auto when single device of that platform.

platform.description: Target platform. Auto when single device of that platform.
